scenarios.title: Living weapon creates a Germ and attaches the Equipment to it
decisions: A casts Flayer Husk, tapping Mountain; B passes and it resolves.
Flayer Husk enters the battlefield and its living weapon trigger goes on the stack.
B passes priority without responding; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: husk_stays
variants.expected: A 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token is created and Flayer Husk is attached to it. Flayer Husk gives +1/+1, so the Germ is 1/1 and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: husk_destroyed_in_response
variants.delta: With the living weapon trigger on the stack, B casts Disenchant targeting Flayer Husk, tapping both Plains; Disenchant resolves first.
variants.expected: Flayer Husk is destroyed and goes to A's graveyard. The living weapon trigger still resolves and creates the Germ token, but there is no Equipment to attach. The Germ is 0/0 and is put into the graveyard by the state-based check, then ceases to exist.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that Forge still creates the Germ when the Equipment has left the battlefield before the trigger resolves.
